data.name: AlDaar
data.gender_notes: AlDaar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Al-Daar means ‘the doorkeeper’. It is a name that signifies protection, security, and hospitality. In Islamic history, Al-Daar refers to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) who was a doorkeeper (Sabiq) for his uncle, Abu Talib, before becoming a Messenger of Allah. The name AlDaar carries the meaning “The Doorkeeper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlDaar usually hope their child will grow to embody the doorkeeper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of protection and hospitality in Islam.
data.etymology: AlDaar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Doorkeeper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlDaar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
